# Fluency (formerly Flashcard AI)

> Language learning platform at [fluency.lat](https://fluency.lat). Modular monolith:
> Rust backend (Axum, Clean/Hexagonal) + React 19 frontend (Vite, registry-based modules).
> Database: **SurrealDB 3.2.3** (GCP dedicated VM, private VPC). Auth: **Google OAuth 2.0 → JWT**.
> Multi-cloud infra (GCP primary, AWS mirror, Azure CI/CD) on 1-2 GB RAM VMs.

**Canonical documentation entry point: [GEMINI.md](GEMINI.md)** (repo root, aliases `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`).
This file is a minimal mirror for agents that do not auto-load root protocols.

## Mandatory Reading Protocol (Before Developing)

1. Architecture: [docs/ARQUITECTURA_MODULAR.md](docs/ARQUITECTURA_MODULAR.md)
2. Module Registry (status and flags): [modules/README.md](modules/README.md)
3. Doc of the module you are working on — ONLY that one: [docs/modules/](docs/modules/)
   (do not read docs for other modules unless declared as dependency)
4. Code guided by "File Map" in module doc — no blind exploration.

In addition, [GEMINI.md](GEMINI.md) defines **task roadmaps** (frontend, backend, servers,
pipeline, DB, media, QA→prod): closed 3-4 document routes with step 0 = sparse-checkout and
an explicit list of places NOT to enter. Follow them — do not explore to get oriented.

## Infrastructure Doc-First Rule

- IPs, RAM, CPU, provider, containers: read FIRST
  [docs/infrastructure/server_inventory.md](docs/infrastructure/server_inventory.md).
  Prohibited to SSH for data this doc already covers.
- SSH/console is fallback only if doc lacks data or contradicts runtime; findings are saved to doc in same change.
- Before touching infra/performance/caching/pipeline: read
  [docs/infrastructure/AI_OPERATIONS_CONTEXT.md](docs/infrastructure/AI_OPERATIONS_CONTEXT.md).

## Closing Rule

A job is not complete until: (1) tested, (2) update module blueprint (`docs/modules/<module>.md`) in same change, (3) `./scripts/verify-blueprints.sh` passing green.

## Main Documentation

- [GEMINI.md](GEMINI.md): full protocol (Gemini Protocol) + master index "If going to X → Read Y".
- [client/GEMINI.md](client/GEMINI.md): frontend (read full before touching `client/`).
- [backend/GEMINI.md](backend/GEMINI.md): Rust backend (workspace, endpoints, adapters).
- [docs/infrastructure/pipeline-and-deploy.md](docs/infrastructure/pipeline-and-deploy.md): canonical CI/CD.
- [docs/QA_TO_PROD_FLOW.md](docs/QA_TO_PROD_FLOW.md): QA → production promotion.
- [docs/DEPLOY_Y_REPOSITORIO.md](docs/DEPLOY_Y_REPOSITORIO.md): Git repo, branches, Azure DevOps.
- [database_schema_diagram.md](database_schema_diagram.md): SurrealDB schema.
- [docs/infrastructure/media-delivery-cache.md](docs/infrastructure/media-delivery-cache.md): media delivery/caching.
- [SECRETS_MAP.md](SECRETS_MAP.md): (LOCAL ONLY) SSH and DB credentials.

## Non-Negotiable Facts

- Production active DB is SurrealDB 3.2.3; PostgreSQL is local docker-compose only, un-utilized.
- Auth exists: Google OAuth 2.0 → JWT (`backend/mod_shell/src/auth.rs`).
- Production primary backend runs in GCP (`35.188.162.50`); Cloud Run is overflow and AWS is mirror.
- Only active pipeline is `azure-pipelines.yml`; branches that deploy: `qa` and `main`.
- `docs/archive/` is historical: does not describe active state.
